en: Return the event cursor that belongs to the session.read snapshot: it is captured before the snapshot is loaded, so a reconnecting client can replay events (and deduplicate by event id) but can never skip the ones appended while the snapshot loaded.
zh-CN: session.read 返回与快照对应的事件游标：游标在读取快照之前取得，重连客户端最多重复收到快照加载期间追加的事件（按 event id 去重），但不会再漏事件。
